description: The job search that runs on your machine. AI job application framework built on Claude Code: evaluate postings, tailor CVs, write cover letters, prep interviews. Fork it and own it.
summary: I starred this because it's the local-first, CLI-native counterpart to what I'm building in Proreerfolio: a fork-and-own workflow where Claude Code evaluates postings, tailors a CV, and runs a drafter-reviewer pass on the cover letter, all on your machine. The composable skill structure—swap the Danish job-portal scrapers for your own market, swap the agent backend if you want—matches how I think about PenguPool and AgentOn Pocket, where the value is in the routing and observation layer rather than a black-box SaaS. And the README's "69 applications, 20 first interviews, 1 signed contract" from a geophysicist who told every employer he was using it is the kind of proof I trust over a polished demo.
